title: Google Search with FlashData
description: Google Search results for your AI agent. Uses FlashData Credits; Apify usage is billed separately. API key: https://flashdata.dev/app/api-keys

query.title: Search query
query.description: One search query, e.g. AI agent tools or site:github.com MCP server.

flashdataApiKey.title: FlashData API key
flashdataApiKey.description: Requires google_search access. Get your key: https://flashdata.dev/app/api-keys

num.title: Requested results
num.description: Maximum results to request (1–100). Actual count may be lower.

gl.title: Country code
gl.description: Two-letter country code, e.g. us, gb or sg.

hl.title: Interface language
hl.description: Google interface language, e.g. en or zh-cn.

location.title: Search location
location.description: Search location, e.g. Singapore or New York.

tbs.title: Google search filter (tbs)
tbs.description: Google filter, e.g. qdr:d (past day), qdr:w (week), qdr:m (month).
